title: The Parent Who Never Said They Were Tired
body:
As children, we often saw our parents working.

What we didn't always see was how exhausted they were.

They continued working when they were tired.
They continued supporting when they were worried.
They continued smiling when they were stressed.

Not because life was easy.

Because responsibility doesn't wait for perfect conditions.

As we grow older, we start noticing these things. We realize that strength is not the absence of struggle. It is the ability to keep moving despite it.

Many of our greatest lessons come not from what our parents taught us, but from what they quietly demonstrated.

"The strongest people are often the ones carrying the heaviest responsibilities."
